answer: Require every agent identity to lock a stake that grows steeply with each extra identity it controls, like a ridge that gets harder to climb the higher you go, so mass-producing fake accounts costs real capital and stops paying off. Reputation must also ripen slowly through repeated verifiable work, the way an orchard yields fruit only after seasons of tending, so a fresh fake starts with nothing. And every attestation is public, so a whisper of fraud can be checked on the ledger by anyone, exposing coordinated fakes quickly.
